clues: This city sits on an open gulf of the Ionian Sea. That gulf lies along the coast of Albania.
This coast gets sun on more than 300 days each year. Its Mediterranean climate keeps the year bright for most days.
Long ago, this was a port town in ancient Epirus. Its people were part of a land called Chaonia.
Visitors today praise one sight above all here. The sea water shines a deep, clear blue.
A Byzantine monastery stands near this coastal city. It honors forty saints from long ago in faith.
